//@version=6
indicator("UCTPROBE_VW_BI_PIVOT_POINT_LEVELS_A", overlay = true)

// U-BUILTIN (2026-11-19). WHAT `ta.pivot_point_levels(type, anchor, developing)` RETURNS, LEVEL BY LEVEL.
//
// The reference names the eleven levels [P, R1, S1, R2, S2, R3, S3, R4, S4, R5, S5] and the six types and
// gives no formula for any of them, nor the value on the bars before the first anchor.
// committed:previous-day-high-and-low-separators-dailyweekly calls
// `ta.pivot_point_levels("Traditional", timeframe.change(tfAuto))`. This half reads Traditional, Fibonacci, Woodie on a weekly
// anchor, developing = false. P is plotted per type; a level the type does not compute reads na.
//
// CAPTURE: AMEX:SPY 1D from the listing and NYSE:RDDT 1D from the listing. Inputs at defaults.

anchor = timeframe.change("W")
plot(bar_index, "P0_bar_index_CONTROL")
lv1 = ta.pivot_point_levels("Traditional", anchor)
plot(array.get(lv1, 0), "Traditional_0")
plot(array.get(lv1, 1), "Traditional_1")
plot(array.get(lv1, 2), "Traditional_2")
plot(array.get(lv1, 3), "Traditional_3")
plot(array.get(lv1, 4), "Traditional_4")

plot(array.get(lv1, 10), "Traditional_10")
lv2 = ta.pivot_point_levels("Fibonacci", anchor)
plot(array.get(lv2, 0), "Fibonacci_0")
plot(array.get(lv2, 1), "Fibonacci_1")

plot(array.get(lv2, 8), "Fibonacci_8")
plot(array.get(lv2, 9), "Fibonacci_9")
plot(array.get(lv2, 10), "Fibonacci_10")
lv3 = ta.pivot_point_levels("Woodie", anchor)
plot(array.get(lv3, 0), "Woodie_0")
plot(array.get(lv3, 1), "Woodie_1")
plot(array.get(lv3, 2), "Woodie_2")
